candidates.description: Description The Forward Deployment Engineer, Reporting Pro helps customers adopt DeepHealth’s Reporting Pro correctly. The role combines radiology reporting depth, clinical workflow knowledge and customer communication to design how Reporting Pro is configured for each customer, build report templates and structured reporting content with radiologists, coach implementation teams, resolve complex technical issues, and turn recurring field needs into standard product workflows, including AI-assisted report drafting as it is released. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Service Engineering Lead, Enterprise Intelligence, and working closely with the DxS lead Forward Deployment Engineer. It operates within DeepHealth’s Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) function, whose purpose is to help customers adopt DeepHealth products correctly. The role sits at the intersection of the Technical Delivery Manager (TDM), Product, Service and Solution Delivery teams to ensure smooth customer adoption. It transitions best practices to the Service and Solution Delivery teams and plans upcoming product changes with them to ensure commercial readiness. candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer at MediaRadar, Inc.
candidates.description: Location: Remote Madrid, Spain (local working hours) About MediaRadar: MediaRadar, now including the data and capabilities of Vivvix, powers the mission-critical marketing and sales decisions that drive competitive advantage. Our competitive advertising intelligence platform enables clients to achieve peak performance with always-on data and insights that span the media, creative, and business strategies of five million brands across 30+ media channels. As we expand our footprint from the US into Europe and deepen our focus on media intelligence, we’re looking for engineers who can help scale our platform and products globally. About the Role: We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Client Apps team and independently own complex, ambiguous problems across our platform. You’ll focus on Insights Studio, our unified insights application, and play a key role in migrating our Creative Intelligence application into the Insights Studio suite. As part of this effort, MediaRadar is consolidating products, each currently running on separate databases, onto a single ClickHouse source of truth. You’ll work agentically, using Claude Code as a core part of how you design, build, and ship. Technical Must-Haves: Agentic Coding: Hands-on, daily use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code) in Visual Studio or VS Code is a must. Core: Expert-level Python (FastAPI), C#, and React/TypeScript.
